react_result.final_narrative_text: Cross-paradigm pathway analysis of eight differentially abundant metabolites identified a dominant, multi-method consensus centred on tryptophan metabolism (KEGG:hsa00380). Four complementary tools converged on the same biological module: RaMP-DB ORA returned KEGG:map00380 as the top hit (FDR = 7.8×10⁻¹³, fold-enrichment 834, five metabolites), Mummichog m/z-direct analysis ranked MUMM:tryptophan_metabolism first (p = 4.2×10⁻⁴, six metabolites including L-tryptophan and its immediate derivatives), MetaboAnalystR PSEA returned KEGG:hsa00380 as the top KEGG hit (p = 5.49×10⁻⁶, four metabolites), and RaMP additionally identified WP:WP4210 "Tryptophan catabolism leading to NAD+ production" (FDR = 2.95×10⁻¹¹, four metabolites) and the IDO metabolic pathway WP:WP5414 (FDR = 3.96×10⁻⁹). The driver metabolites span two parallel branches from the parent substrate L-tryptophan (CHEBI:16828): the kynurenine arm produces quinolinic acid (CHEBI:16675) and 3-hydroxyanthranilic acid (CHEBI:15793), while the serotonin arm produces serotonin (CHEBI:28790) and its N-acetylated derivative melatonin (CHEBI:16796). The simultaneous elevation of both arms suggests a global shift in tryptophan allocation, consistent with activation of indoleamine 2,3-dioxygenase (IDO1) and a pro-inflammatory tryptophan depletion signature. 3-Methyladenine (CHEBI:38635) and O-phosphoethanolamine (CHEBI:17553) likely reflect parallel purine and phospholipid perturbations not captured by the tryptophan-centric enrichment.

  "narrative_text": "Cross-paradigm pathway analysis of eight differentially abundant metabolites identified a dominant, multi-method consensus centred on tryptophan metabolism (KEGG:hsa00380). Four complementary tools converged on the same biological module: RaMP-DB ORA returned KEGG:map00380 as the top hit (FDR = 7.8×10⁻¹³, fold-enrichment 834, five metabolites), Mummichog m/z-direct analysis ranked MUMM:tryptophan_metabolism first (p = 4.2×10⁻⁴, six metabolites including L-tryptophan and its immediate derivatives), MetaboAnalystR PSEA returned KEGG:hsa00380 as the top KEGG hit (p = 5.49×10⁻⁶, four metabolites), and RaMP additionally identified WP:WP4210 \"Tryptophan catabolism leading to NAD+ production\" (FDR = 2.95×10⁻¹¹, four metabolites) and the IDO metabolic pathway WP:WP5414 (FDR = 3.96×10⁻⁹). The driver metabolites span two parallel branches from the parent substrate L-tryptophan (CHEBI:16828): the kynurenine arm produces quinolinic acid (CHEBI:16675) and 3-hydroxyanthranilic acid (CHEBI:15793), while the serotonin arm produces serotonin (CHEBI:28790) and its N-acetylated derivative melatonin (CHEBI:16796). The simultaneous elevation of both arms suggests a global shift in tryptophan allocation, consistent with activation of indoleamine 2,3-dioxygenase (IDO1) and a pro-inflammatory tryptophan depletion signature. 3-Methyladenine (CHEBI:38635) and O-phosphoethanolamine (CHEBI:17553) likely reflect parallel purine and phospholipid perturbations not captured by the tryptophan-centric enrichment.",
